one_sentence: The exponential decay of post-Flood lifespans in Genesis 5 and 11 converges on a floor of ~93 years, which Psalm 90 and modern data confirm as a grace-maintained minimum Logos-coupling.
executive_summary: This document argues that the lifespan data in Genesis chapters 5 and 11, when plotted against generation number, fit an exponential decay model with high precision (R²=0.888), revealing an asymptotic floor of approximately 93 years. This floor is not arbitrary but corresponds to the 'threescore years and ten' of Psalm 90:10 and the modern global average life expectancy of ~73 years. The exponential shape indicates compounding generational entropy—a heritable degradation of informational fidelity to the Logos introduced at the Fall. The floor is held by common grace, the χ vacuum ground state that prevents total decoherence. The conclusion is that the Genesis lifespan record is a measurable biological dataset, not mythology, and that the floor represents the minimum coupling to the Logos required for human life.
short_summary: This document is a data-driven analysis of the lifespans recorded in Genesis 5 and 11. The core structural claim is that post-Flood lifespans decay exponentially toward a floor of ~93 years, not linearly or randomly. The key evidence is the exponential curve fit (R²=0.888) and the convergence of the model's floor with Psalm 90:10 and modern life expectancy. This matters because it suggests the Genesis data is a precise measurement record of generational entropy, with the floor held by common grace as a minimum Logos-coupling.
